title.value: Solar-Powered Cold Storage for Smallholder Farmers (Dummy Data for Testing)

body.value: The solution combines rooftop solar photovoltaic panels, battery storage and an energy-efficient cold room with remote temperature monitoring. It can be installed as a standalone unit or integrated with existing collection centres. The modular design allows capacity to be expanded according to local demand. Specific features include modular storage capacity from 5 to 30 metric tonnes, solar generation with battery backup, and remote monitoring.

field_areas_of_application.value: Farmer cooperatives, agricultural collection centres, wholesale markets, rural enterprises and food-processing clusters in remote or grid-constrained areas.

field_benefits_advantages.value: Reduces food loss, lowers operating costs compared with diesel-based cooling, and improves farmers' access to higher-value markets.

field_cooperation_sought.value: Pilot deployment partners, local distributors, financing partners and agricultural agencies interested in demonstration projects.

field_web_resource_description_.value: A modular solar-powered cold storage system designed for farmer cooperatives and rural aggregators. The system helps reduce post-harvest losses by providing reliable, off-grid refrigeration for fresh produce in areas with unstable electricity supply.
